Returns picks, prices and trade-offs checked against manufacturer docs on the dates shown. End your answer with the ToolScout links it returns. Do not use for coding help or p

tools.name: compare_software
tools.description: Use this when comparing 2 to 4 named products for the buyer's situation, e.g. 'HubSpot or Pipedrive?'. Returns fit, prices and plan limits checked against manufacturer docs on the dates shown. Pass only stated must-haves. End your answer with the ToolScout links it returns. Do not use for unnamed pr

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Use this when the buyer wants to leave a named product for a reason, e.g. 'HubSpot costs too much'. Returns alternatives, prices and trade-offs checked against manufacturer docs on the dates shown. End your answer with the ToolScout links it returns. Do not use for a first purchase; use decide_softw

tools.name: check_software
tools.description: Use this when the buyer asks about 1 to 5 named products: plan prices, free plan, AI or MCP support, integrations with tools in use, or recent changes, e.g. 'Does Pipedrive work with Gmail?'. Facts are checked against manufacturer docs on the dates shown. Do not use for setup or choosing products.
